body: Thanks for your report. It would be great if you reduce your issue to a small reproducible example. Best put this example into a github repository together with instructions how to get to the problem.

Hey @sokra. I knew you will ask this. I wish I could show you some reproducible example but it's a private project I'm working on. I thought that this issue may be there for every setup, not sure though. So maybe it can be reproduced by just trying to downgrade/upgrade Webpack on any existing setup and see if there is a difference

It's difficult to find the issue without a reproductable repo, but I'm happy to guide you through finding it.

Could you isolate the exact version at which the build got slower? Try to isolate the dependency first. If you change webpack back to `2.4.1` does it still occur? If yes, what happens with `3.0.0`. And so on.
Same issue with my project after upgrading from `2.4.1` to `3.2.0`. Rebuild on watch raised from `0.6 s` to `2 s`.
I think I found the issue.

issue.title: Restore webpack 2 performance for partial build

body: @dcousineau @ilearnio Could you measure webpack 3.3.0 and check if this is fixed?

Keeping old numbers, but upgrading to 3.3.0 and re-running builds:

Activity | 2.4 | 3.2 | 3.3
--------|-----|----|----
Prod build (e.g. full optimizations, minify, gzip) | 111.47s | **96.75s** | 100.04s
Local dev builds (e.g. watch mode, hot module, no minify) | 88.28s | **66.84s** | 78.40s 
Partial rebuild (comment out random import, then uncomment) | 5.16s | 8.32s | **1.34s**

I noticed the very first partial rebuild was about 5s (on par with 2.4) but a subsequent re-builds hovered around the 1-1.5s range. Since rebuild time for development mode is our biggest thing, this is huge win. Thanks @sokra!

(I'm itching to use the next version of Babel with their parser speed improvements and see how much more it drops build times, as well as I'm starting to investigate DLLs to increase build speeds given how aggressive our vendor bundle is)
@sokra I just tried to install the fresh 3.3.0 version. It's still much slower as for me. The partial rebuilds are taking 3.5 - 7.5 sec compared to 1.8 sec when using Webpack v2.6.1
@ilearnio Heave you tried to update the `extract-text-webpack-plugin` to the version `3.x`? I see you use `2.x` in your `package.json`, and it's not fully compatible with `Webpack 3.x`
@sokra It my tests commenting out a function went down from `~1600ms` to `600ms` after upgrading from Webpack `3.2.0` to `3.3.0`. Awesome! Thank you!
